Population increased in Islington

The estimated population of Islington in 2024 was 223,024 usual residents, a rise of 0.3% since 2023.

This meant that Islington's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Islington increased by 2.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, Islington was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Islington

The average (median) age stayed at 32.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Islington has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Islington is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Islington's population of 223,024 usual residents was made up of:

  • 31,683 people aged 0 to 15 years, (14.2%)
  • 169,711 people aged 16 to 64 years, (76.1%)
  • 21,630 people aged 65 years and over, (9.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Islington has a higher proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (76.1% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Islington, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Islington
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Islington, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 1,208 people (0.5%). In total, there were 2,269 births and 1,061 deaths in Islington.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 3,826 (-1.7%). There were 26,985 people entering the area and 30,811 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Islington's population of 3,465 (1.6%) as a result of 10,040 people entering the area and 6,575 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Islington was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Islington in mid-2023 is 222,333.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,569 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 180 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,749 people.
